limitations: Synthetic software acceptance only; no biological inference, source authenticity, correction, physical validity, causality or clinical validity is established.

Exact rank uses decimal rational values. One-way metrics and within-group permutations cannot establish adjusted attribution. Missing and constant features are excluded by the frozen label-free rule; no imputation or group-based filtering is supported.
Hash/timestamp declarations cannot prove historical timing or independence. One table never establishes replication. Missing QC comparisons remain unavailable.

The conservative case-insensitive whole-word English gate permits word-character suffixes for caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*. It also refuses truth, physical validity, biological signal, differential expression, correct*, remov*, and group-adjust* wording. It is incomplete and refuses negations too.

Confounded absence wording is refused. Unavailable text additionally refuses supported, replicated, suggestive and significan*. Any unavailable kind or result forces unavailable status. Positive support checks both kind and result; outside labels are checked against own output paths and hashes.
Rigor and independent source, record and method review stay with the coordinator; pack review remains unavailable.
